canonical_sd_D_note: well-powered estimate from n=5000; the n=200 value 0.0169715 is 1.03 combined-across-counts SE high (the n=200 and n=5000 errors in quadrature) and should be recorded alongside, not replaced; see excursion_se_referents for the within-window_sd and within-window_mean SE referents
control_band_defect_is_scale_not_width: The defect was that the band did not scale with n, not that it was narrow. SE(sd) = sd/sqrt(2(n-1)), so [0.0168, 0.0171] is ~0.35 SE wide at n=5000 but only ~0.09 SE wide at n=200 — the same band is a DIFFERENT test at every replicate count, and it is that non-scaling which makes it near-certain to reject a valid re-run.

correction.nested_prefix_warning: a first-200 nested-prefix match is true BY CONSTRUCTION when the loops are identical and therefore is NOT a stream test; the stream control should be built from SE(sd) around the convergent estimate, not from a small-n point estimate
correction.stream_confirmation_evidence: an independent 5000-replicate reproduction of the same loop and seed produces sd=0.0160786624, mean=+0.0024295367, skew=-0.008893, matching this artifact to every printed digit
correction.what: sd_control_ok was false due to a mis-specified tolerance, not a measurement failure
correction.why: the band applied the n=5000 standard error (~1%) to a comparison whose reference is an n=200 point estimate (~5% standard error); a band ~0.35 SE wide around a 200-replicate estimate

excursion_se_referents_note: combined_across_counts answers 'is the n=200 value consistent with the n=5000 value'; within_window_sd answers 'how far is the n=200 value from the convergent estimate in its own sampling units'.

lengths_construction_all_identical.diagnosis_block_counts: block_counts builds blocks from slices and lengths from their lengths, producing [64]*937 + [32] for N=60000 and B=64
lengths_construction_all_identical.verified_observation: All three constructions are identical. An earlier claim of a differing construction was made in an agent message and is retracted; this artifact records the verified state.

notes: Outer replicates reuse the diagnosis-of-record loop structure from track5_between_block_diagnosis.py: shared Generator, A draw, B draw, then 32 inner multinomial redraw pairs consumed before the next outer replicate. Outer seed 20260919 matches DIAGNOSIS_SEED=20260919. Bootstrap percentile CI uses 20000 resamples with bootstrap seed 20260920. Conclusion is about the modelled block law at this design, never about real traffic.
proposition_tested: the signed deviation D = tv_hat - TRUE_TV is negatively skewed
sd_D_by_replicate_count_note: Independent reproduction of the same loop and seed; the convergence trajectory makes the shift from the n=200 point estimate visible.
sd_band_checks_at_other_counts_note: Only the un-scaled hand-set band rejects them; the n=3000 window is inside a correctly scaled band and is not evidence of control failure.
se_convention: SE(sd) = V/sqrt(2(n-1)) with V the CONVERGENT estimate; a window's own sd is NOT used, since centring a band on the window's own value would make containment trivial and the control unable to fail.
skewness_by_replicate_count_note: The sequence crosses zero TWICE, making the sign non-resolvable concrete as a sequence rather than a single number.
skewness_formula: g1 = m3 / m2**1.5, with m2=mean((D-mean(D))**2) and m3=mean((D-mean(D))**3) using 1/n central moments

stream_reproduced.method: reused track5_between_block_diagnosis.py loop order with 32 rng.multinomial redraw pairs per outer replicate

trajectory_note: The sd does NOT converge monotonically (it dips at n=3000 before rising), so no single window is a checkpoint at any n — a run validated only at n=3000 lands FURTHER from the final estimate than the n=200 start does. That is the primary reason a control must be anchored to a convergent estimate with an n-scaled band, rather than to any prefix.
